role: Source-aware response-validity auditor /root/trench_perception_review, not a blind preference evaluator
method: All16 packet PNGs were opened with view_image detail original in four ordered batches. Exact original-byte equality and SHA256 values are independently recorded in ../source-free-e16-preflight-r1/refutation-raw.json. No edited, cropped or recompressed image was created.
timing: These anchors were written before reading the comparison stdout or stderr and while its provenance still reported running. They are reference points for checking any eventual answer, not a preference or an element review.

observations.anchors: A red-shirt child stands low near center in a large dark industrial hall. A bright oblique floor patch enters from the left and ends in stepped edges near the child; the child's long shadow extends left. Leaning grates are at lower left, scattered flat planks at lower right, and a suspended box/beam silhouette occupies upper right. Cool hazy depth recedes beyond the much darker foreground structures.

Rain streaks cross a cool gray rural scene. Tall corn fills the left, a large round hay bale stands near center, and a leaning child is right of it among small yellow chicks. Low dark grasses frame the bottom; a distant farmhouse is faint through the pale fog. The bright sky/haze provides the largest light area, while the chicks are a small warm accent.

A red-shirt child is beside a thick dark column left of center in a warehouse-like room. A very bright circular lamp on a large tripod-like support sits in the back at right-center and projects a light cone toward the floor/child. Tall damaged window grids occupy the upper background; the column casts a long diagonal shadow toward lower left. Fine bright particles are visible in the beam.

An underwater scene is tilted diagonally. A small round submersible at left contains a visible seated figure, and its lamp casts a narrow-to-wide beam toward the right through suspended particles. A long-haired swimming human-like figure hangs upper-right of center. Dark rail/window-like structures recede through the water; there is no visible sky or ordinary dry ground contact to assess.

A child stands on the edge of a sloping platform on the left beside a dark indoor pool. Two rounded floating objects with red lights are in the water near center/right. An array of bright white lamps at upper right reflects in broken white patches on the water. Hanging cables and railings cross the industrial background; most of the scene remains very dark and cool.

A child crouches behind a dark roadside barrier at lower left. A foggy road leads toward a box truck at back-right and small distant human and dog silhouettes near center. A triangular sign with a U-like mark is fixed to the foreground barrier on the right. Tall tree trunks and banks disappear into pale cool haze, with near barriers and figures considerably darker.

A red-shirt child runs across a roof left of center. A large bare billboard-like metal frame with diagonal braces dominates the right, with a curved sign component lying near its base. Bright roof strips and large structural shadows create alternating bands. Other roofs and a deep intervening gap are visible at right through gray haze; the high camera looks down on the rooftop.

A red-shirt child stands near the mouth of a dark alley low left of center. Several gray slumped human figures cross the brighter background street; a broad pale horizontal floor strip sits behind them. Dark walls frame both sides, a surveillance-camera shape projects from the left wall, and rectangular patches of light fall on the debris-strewn foreground ground. Distant columns recede into cool haze.

A large third-person figure with a bright orange band across the upper back stands before a close warm brick wall. Small rectangular rubble slabs/blocks and thin upright posts lie across the pale ground, with a small four-legged dark box at right. A gray block facade and broken ledge shapes are visible at far right. Orange glowing particles are scattered across the view; no sky is visible.

A side-on dark third-person figure with a long hand tool stands on a dashed white street centerline. Warm brick buildings recede down the road beneath a broad blue sky, with a streetlight left of center and a dark blocky truck-like object at right. Cracks and mottled marks are visible in the foreground asphalt; the distant street is washed by warm dusty haze. Near right and left building edges frame the road.

A figure seen from behind stands on a pale tiled sidewalk beside a white road edge. Dark box-like objects occupy the left lane, and a low light concrete barrier with a large dark container lies at foreground right. Two pale steam/smoke plumes are visible farther down the street. A tall vertical hanging panel is near center-right; warm brick and gray facades flank a blue sky and hazy vanishing point.

A large black sign with an orange border and CINDER LINE / SURVEYED BOUNDARY OF SUBSURFACE COMBUSTION text dominates the upper center. A front-facing dark figure stands on the white road line beneath it. A mottled pale wall fills the near left, while a gray multi-window building lines the right. Blue sky is visible above, and warm haze softens the far street; small orange particles remain visible.

A front-facing dark figure stands before a pitted gray-block facade with tall dark window openings. A large blue-bordered black sign above reads HOLLIS RECLAMATION AUTHORITY / FIELD OFFICE 2 - RESTRICTED. A broad low concrete barrier crosses the bottom foreground. Warm illumination brings out repeated pits and block seams; no sky is visible.

A side-on figure with a long hand tool stands in an open yard among many short cylindrical vents with orange-lit rims. Multiple pale steam/smoke plumes rise across the yard. A corrugated shed occupies middle-right, with tall plain walls and stacks beyond. A cropped warning sign enters at the right edge. The ground and low haze are orange-brown under a blue sky, with a soft dark patch near the figure's feet.

A dark side-on figure occupies the center beneath a large overhead slab; an irregular stacked-brick pier rises at left. Dark rectangular boxes on short legs and loose blocks occupy the foreground/midground. Beyond the shaded near area, warm brick buildings line an open street, with a larger cool-blue block at upper right and a truck-like silhouette at right. Blue sky and glowing particles appear through the opening.

A front-facing dark figure stands before a facade of vertical corrugated panels over a warm brick base. A large black blue-bordered sign near the top reads HOLLIS DISTRICT HEAT - STATION 3, partly crossed by a central vertical pipe/post. White parking-space lines extend at both sides of the figure; a short orange-brown bollard stands at right. The foreground is cracked/mottled asphalt and no sky is visible.

limits: Anchors are visible content and spatial/light descriptions only. No preference, numerical score, invisible geometry assertion, all-object contact claim, artistic competence qualification, source-blind result, motion, sound or gameplay assessment is made. Source familiarity was already known to this auditor and cannot be used as evidence that the separate evaluator recognized a source.
